verses.text: Praise the LORD! Sing a new song to the LORD. Praise him in the gathering of his faithful people.
Let Israel be glad because of their Maker. Let the people of Zion be full of joy because of their King.
Let them praise his name with dancing. Let them make music to him with tambourine and harp.
The LORD takes delight in his people. He crowns humble people with victory.
Let his faithful people celebrate his glory. Let them sing for joy on their beds.
Let the praises of God be in their mouths and a two-edged sword in their hands,
to punish the nations and bring judgment on the peoples,
to tie up their kings with chains and their leaders with iron shackles,
to carry out the judgment written against them. This is the honour of all his faithful people. Praise the LORD!
